*To configure a newly created plugin right-click it and select properties (bottommost item).*

  *   From the properties dialog first select Java Code Style -> Cleanup (1), check Enable project specific settings (2) and then Import (3) the following cleanup [http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/unicaseCleanUp.xml file here..]

<br>
http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/15ad2.png

  *   Next select Java Code Style -> Code Templates (1), check Enable project specific settings (2) and then Import (3) the code-template xml [http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/unicasecodetemplates.xml file here..]


<br>
http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/81d92.png


 *   Now select Java Code Style -> Formatter (1), check Enable project specific settings (2) and then Import (3) the UNICASE formatter [http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/unicaseFormatter.xml file here..]


<br>
http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/f8298.png

<br>
<br>
 * Please also configure the project specific warnings as detailed in the [http://code.google.com/p/unicase/wiki/Coding_Guidelines Coding Guidelines]:
<br> 
http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/1u.png
<br>
<br>
http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/2u.png
<br>
<br>
 * Finally go to Java Editor -> Save Actions (1), check Enable project specific settings (2) and then configure it as follows:
<br>
http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/3u.png
